title: Cosmic Sorceress on Cliff
description: A woman in a flowing black hooded cloak and high heels stands on a rocky cliff edge overlooking a dark ocean. She extends her arm as a swirling vortex of glowing blue flowers, petals, stars, and galaxies emanates from her into the night sky, with the cosmic scene reflected in the water below.
prompt: A mysterious woman with long flowing black hair wearing a dark hooded cloak and high heels stands on a rocky cliff at night, overlooking a dark ocean. She extends her hand as a magical burst of glowing blue flowers, petals, stars, galaxies and nebulae swirl around her into the starry sky, with the cosmic elements reflecting in the water below, dramatic god rays from above, ethereal fantasy scene
